text: Hold SUPPORT, small. A buy stop over yesterday's high is not a chase on my method: only price takes me in, never a market order (C5, C27), and strength above a broken line is the position system's entry (C26). D dist_to_20bar_high_pct 1.58 means the stop trails to each new prior-day high until one breaks. Trigger I stand behind: trade_above:bar_high on D. Printing minervini's stage-2 unconfirmed note on the ticket is fine by me; it is his test, not mine. Cautions: thin 63-day edge, subcomponents.flow.cmf unserved. Wrong if a daily close below max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d).
